replication.target_description: Study 2: Prolific Replication of the Original Experiment 1; poem described as requiring 18 versus 4 hours. Outcome/test correspondence unresolved: liking/quality, monetary value, and time/effort ratings are reported.

es.location: Study 2, Results and Discussion: Liking/Quality; Monetary value; Time/Effort (Table 4 also summarizes liking/quality and monetary value). Supplied p.3 locator does not distinguish the outcome.
es.quote: Participants rated the poem as higher quality in the high effort condition (M = 6.73, SD = 1.95) compared to the low effort condition (M = 6.31, SD = 1.78; t(698) = 3.00, p = .003, d = 0.23, 95% CI [0.08, 0.38], see Figure 2). ... We found no support for difference between log-transformed monetary value in the low effort (M = 5.01, SD = 1.87) and the high effort conditions (M = 4.86, SD = 1.88; t(698) = 1.00, p = .32, d = 0.08, 95% CI [-0.07, 0.22]). ... Participants rated the poem as taking more time and effort in the high effort condition (n = 356, M = 7.72, SD = 2.00) compared to the low effort condition (n = 344, M = 5.98, SD = 1.76), t(698) = 12.24, p < .001, d = 0.93, 95% CI [0.76, 1.09], confirming a successful manipulation.
